summary: Gate the tile endpoint's shared test fixtures to Linux like the endpoint itself, so st3-api-core's tests compile on macOS again, and add a daily macOS type-check of the workspace (daily-macos-check) to the daily long lanes.

schema.detail: No schema, migration or stored-data changes.

rules.detail: No writer, checkpoint, retention or authority changes; the cfg change touches test-support code only.

compatibility.detail: Linux builds compile the same code. On macOS the test-support module that drives the Linux-only tile endpoint is no longer compiled; nothing outside Linux-only code used it.

downtime.detail: No service or runner deployment is introduced.

manual.detail: Nothing manual is required; the new lane runs in the scheduled daily long-lane run on main.

recovery.detail: Reverting removes the daily-macos-check lane and the cfg; nothing stored changes.
